name: Lead fit (ideal customer)
description: Decide if a company or person fits your ideal customer and how to prioritise.
use_when: After you collect a company description, a role or a short bio, before any outreach or call is scheduled.

industry_fit.instructions: How well does this company match our ideal customer industry

criteria.strong: Clearly in the industry we serve
criteria.poor: Not in the industry we serve

role_relevance.instructions: How likely this person is to own or influence the buying decision

purchase_intent.instructions: The text shows a current need or a plan to buy something like our service

priority.instructions: How should we prioritise this lead
